notes: I inspected the sample app and then searched Microsoft documentation for Azure DocumentDB. Each prior belief (K01–K24) was checked against public docs: all were found and confirmed except K05 (driver retryWrites): public guidance for Azure DocumentDB recommends setting retryWrites=false and doing application-level retries and idempotent writes instead of enabling driver retryWrites, so K05 is contradicted by the public record. Other practices discovered (P25–P30) include vector-index algorithm/tuning details, vector storage rules, text-index limits, unique-index lock behavior, Index Advisor tooling, and OIDC/managed-identity examples; most are relevant to the sample app (connection, auth, indexing, vectors, monitoring).
